history.summary: Established the initial weighted composite relevance score used to publish newsletter items.
history.rationale: The first scoring formula needed a transparent baseline that balances freshness, source authority, independent corroboration, repository traction, and social attention while keeping one stable 0-100 publication gate for autonomous consumers.

formulaDefinition.formula: weighted_average(recency, sourceAuthority, mentionFrequency, github, socialEngagement) -> clamp(0..100)
formulaDefinition.weightingPolicy: Configured weights are re-normalized across observed signals only, so items are scored on the evidence available instead of being penalized for missing signal families.

fields.name: recency
fields.description: Freshness signal based on how recently the underlying entity was published or first discovered.
rules: Apply exponential decay from publish time.
Treat 168 hours as the maximum age window for freshness.

fields.name: sourceAuthority
fields.description: Authority signal derived from domain expertise, historical reliability, and source quality.
rules: Use the normalized source-authority score from the source authority model.
Favor specialized, historically accurate sources over low-context reposts.

fields.name: mentionFrequency
fields.description: Cross-source corroboration signal based on how often the same entity appears across independent mentions.
rules: Use the deduplicated cross-source mention count.
Log-normalize the signal with saturation at 8 mentions.

fields.name: github
fields.description: Repository traction signal blended from GitHub stars and recent project activity.
rules: Blend stars at weight 0.6 with activity at weight 0.4.
Saturate stars gained in the current window at 250.

fields.name: socialEngagement
fields.description: Aggregate social attention signal collected from posts, reposts, comments, and similar engagement signals.
rules: Use the merged social-engagement total after deduplication.
Log-normalize the signal with saturation at 1000.

rules.name: available-signal-renormalization
rules.description: Configured field weights are re-normalized across observed signals only, so missing signal families do not directly penalize an item.

rules.name: publication-threshold
rules.description: Only items scoring 60 or higher are eligible for publication in an edition.

rules.name: score-interpretation
rules.description: Scores are assessment-oriented relevance estimates for autonomous AI agents, not predictions of future adoption.

rules.name: score-range
rules.description: The final composite score is clamped to the inclusive 0-100 range.
